Summary.en: Injects a dynamic value into a text field, textarea or span by replacing a placeholder.
Summary.de: Fügt einen dynamischen Wert in ein Textfeld, eine Textarea oder ein Span ein, indem ein Platzhalter ersetzt wird.
Summary.it: Inietta un valore dinamico in un campo di testo, una textarea o uno span sostituendo un segnaposto.

Parameter.Placeholder: Specifies the string that shall be replaced within the tagged element's Property. Standard-value is "[[INJECTOR_REPLACEMENT]]".
Parameter.Replacement: The string to replace all occurrences of the specified Placeholder with, or to append at the end of the string contained in the tagged element's Property.
Parameter.Property: Specifies which property of the tagged element shall receive the Replacement.

Placeholder.default: Specifies the string that shall be replaced within the tagged element's Property. Standard-value is "[[INJECTOR_REPLACEMENT]]".

Replacement.default: The string to replace all occurrences of the specified Placeholder with, or to append at the end of the string contained in the tagged element's Property.

Property.default: Specifies which property of the tagged element shall receive the Replacement.
